posts.body_html:
totally missed your question Neotropical! Hmmm, probably not an early grower, it might seem that way since the traps opened up early this year, but I think that might be due to microclimates from one community tray to the next. Plants that are in the "front" and have direct sun hitting the soil tend to form traps earlier. I think this is because the plants overall are kept warmer, so they grow sooner.
